meta.description: Circuit A only. Condition D: all 27 Kickoff 31 pairs at once. Conditions S1, S2: only the 12 test pairs (6 that kept least, 6 that kept most), split into groups with no two active pairs coupled. Each position's counts cover that condition's active pairs, in the order of selection.dense_pairs (D) or selection.groups (S1, S2).
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0; pair i is measured into classical bits 2i (its first qubit) and 2i + 1 (its second)
